title: Croissant version decision: 1.0 pinned vs 1.1 DUO/PROV-O adoption (M0 exit criterion)
context: PLAN.md v0.2 retargets the Croissant spec to v1.1 (which adds DUO/PROV-O permission+provenance layers and MCP, directly encoding access-tier/consent as ontology terms) but requires a recorded decision: either adopt 1.1 now, or pin 1.0 transitionally with a scheduled bump. This version decision is an M0 exit criterion and is separate from croissant-007 (which builds the generator targeting the decided version). Without a recorded decision, the generator, validators, and golden fixtures cannot be pinned to a stable spec. Dependencies: croissant-007 (the generator task must wait on this decision). Binding cancer guardrails apply.
objective: Record the Croissant version decision (1.0 pinned transitionally with scheduled bump, or 1.1 DUO/PROV-O adopted immediately), documenting the rationale, the maturity/compatibility assessment, and the scheduled bump date if 1.0 is held.
acceptanceCriteria: Decision document committed to /docs/croissant-version-decision.md recording which version is adopted (1.0 or 1.1) with the rationale: maturity, DUO/PROV-O readiness for access-tier encoding, tool ecosystem compatibility.
If 1.0 is held transitionally: a scheduled bump milestone is named (no later than M2), and specVersions records the pinned version with the bump date.
If 1.1 is adopted: the DUO and PROV-O layers to be used for access-tier/consent encoding are identified and listed; any known tooling gaps noted.
specVersions entry updated with the decided version and effective date.
croissant-007 acceptance criteria are cross-referenced to confirm they will target the decided version.
